issue: High-velocity rifle penetration vs biological areal density limits
impact: Arresting 7.62x39mm or 5.56x45mm rifle projectiles requires areal density > 25 kg/m^2. A biological organism cannot carry this weight over full torso without severe locomotor collapse.

issue: Major conduit vascular transection remains unsolvable by biochemistry alone
impact: Transection of abdominal aorta or proximal femoral artery loses >1.5 L/min under high shear stress; biological survival requires active mechanical vascular clamping or external tourniquets.

issue: Axon regeneration velocity biological rate limit (1-2 mm/day)
impact: Functional motor re-innervation after severe nerve laceration takes months. No known molecular mechanism can accelerate tubulin transport by an order of magnitude without axonal death.

issue: Thermoregulation during prolonged high-intensity combat exertion in humid ambient conditions
impact: In hot/humid environments (wet-bulb > 30 C), evaporative sweat dissipation drops sharply; even zoned armor (30% occlusion) may cause core temperature accumulation during sustained running.

issue: Mineral turnover and calcium-phosphate dietary metabolic demands of osteoderm armor
impact: Maintaining and repairing 7-10 kg of mineralized osteoderms requires massive calcium, phosphate, and vitamin D metabolic mobilization, straining parathyroid and renal regulation.

issue: Developmental and ontogenetic morphogenesis of rigid subdermal plates
impact: How rigid osteoderms grow during embryogenesis and childhood without restricting organismal growth requires coordinated sutural expansion and osteoclast remodeling.

issue: Absence of empirical in vivo ballistic impact data on living bioengineered dermal composites
impact: Current tissue mechanics and wave attenuation models are derived from excised animal carapaces and finite element analogs; in vivo dynamic biological validation is currently prohibited (NO_GO).

issue: Discrepancy between Mode I crack propagation (48.6 N) and blunt guillotine wedging (680 N) for FGM biomaterials
impact: Resolved by updating MODEL-12 and MODEL-14 to explicitly calculate both regimes and document draw slicing reduction (32.4 N).

issue: Unsubstantiated claim of 92% muscle force recovery in 5 days post PEG-fusion and rodent-human equivalence in VML
impact: Resolved by formal retraction (INV-0013, NEG-0061), calibration with human clinical trials (SRC-0109, SRC-0110, SRC-0111, SRC-0112), and updated MODEL-13.

issue: Epistemic discrepancies in VML volume recovery metrics, Atkins slicing factor multiplier, and thermoregulatory flux definitions
impact: Resolved in Cycle 4B by formal retractions (INV-0015, INV-0016), independent 3-track external validation gate (EXP-0069), knife/scalpel geometric distinction in MODEL-12, and unified first-law energy balance in MODEL-14.

issue: Forensic discovery of synthetic clinical records, biomaterials data leakage, and premature whole-body biohybrid claims
impact: Resolved in Cycle 4C by authentic data reconstruction (PMC5744714), LOPO-CV evaluation, true prediction error re-calculation (9.15%), and formal downgrading of validation verdicts in DEC-0029.

issue: Dogmatic assertion of universal 3-5 satellite cell cycle limit and 200 um tissue death in previous cycles
impact: Rectified in Cycle 6 Phase 1 by establishing metabolic-rate-dependent diffusion scaling and asymmetric stem cell self-renewal dynamics.

issue: Lack of independent multi-species external holdout verification for volumetric muscle loss recovery beyond Dziki 2016
impact: Resolved in Cycle 6 Question B by evaluating independent rodent and porcine holdouts (Corona 2015, Greising 2017/2020, Garg 2015) with TRANSLATIONAL_UNVALIDATED flags.

issue: Discrepancy in environmental relative humidity between Montain 1994 experimental data (50% RH) and model simulation (80% RH)
impact: Resolved in Cycle 6 Question C by simulating strictly matched 50% RH and 1.5 clo uncompensable heat stress conditions.

issue: Conflation of group aggregate averages with independent individual specimen measurements in Cycle 6
impact: Resolved in Cycle 7 Phase 1 by forensic audit, CSV provenance ledger, and classification of all 11 VML records as cohort means.

issue: Bibliographic attribution errors for pangolin scales (Wang 2016 Acta Biomater) and sheep horn (Trim 2011 Acta Biomater)
impact: Resolved in Cycle 7 Phase 2 by correcting DOIs and primary publication details.

issue: Inaccurate air velocity (1.0 m/s vs authentic 2.2 m/s) in Montain et al. 1994 thermoregulation simulation
impact: Resolved in Cycle 7 Phase 4 by re-running simulation under true 2.2 m/s wind speed.

issue: Diffusion-limited central core necrosis and motor endplate senescence in human-scale VML translation
impact: Highlights critical bio-engineering gap: pre-vascularized scaffolds and neurotrophic guiding channels required for human translation.

issue: Conflation of Macroscopic Layer Geometry with Nanoscale Fibrillar Volume Fractions in Published Literature
impact: Cycle 8 mistakenly equated 38% ventral macro-layer thickness with intermediate filament volume fraction. Fully audited and resolved in Cycle 9.
